messages:
ana: FYI discovered anomalous KMS sign activity on prod key during routine scan. Not expected from our build windows. Putting a temporary hold on base-image rebase rollout.

sec-bot: Alert: UnusualCryptoUsage detected for key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/artifacts/cryptoKeys/prod-image-signer at 2026-04-02T02:41:12Z. 3 distinct principals used outside scheduled builders. (rule: kms-unexpected-principal-v1)

kyle: Is this a false positive from the new CI workers? Which principals?

sec-bot: Principals flagged: serviceAccount:unknown-worker@external.iam.gserviceaccount.com, serviceAccount:ci-runner-2@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com, user:deploy-bot@redwood.internal. Source IPs flagged: 34.120.12.4, 34.120.12.5.

ana: Wait, @ana is me — typo. I meant: I saw signatures produced at 02:41 that don't match our builder image digests. Could be a leaked cosign key reference or mis-scoped workload identity.

ops-rita: Spinning up quick audit: gcloud logging read 'resource.type=k8s_container AND protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign"' --limit=50 --project=redwood-prod | jq '.'

auditor-marc: I'm seeing missing entries for 02:35-02:50 for KMS admin and access logs. Our logging sink to log-audit-prod shows health check failure 03/30. Need to ensure we have durable evidence before touching keys.

paul: If principals are truly external, we need to revoke key bindings immediately and rotate the key. That will block all signing until we re-key and re-sign images. Isolate risk first.

kyle: Proposed containment steps: 1) Add conditional deny via org policy? Not available quickly. 2) Remove all external members from key IAM immediately. 3) Rotate key (create new key version and update cosign references). 4) Rebuild affected images and verify signatures.

sec-bot: Recommendation: apply temporary deny for members matching '*external*' and create a new key version with destruction policy disabled.

ops-rita: We need to preserve forensic trail. I'll export current logs to gs://redwood-audit-evidence/SEC-5187/ before any key rotation. ETA 10m.

ana: While Rita exports, I'm going to snapshot the registries for images signed in the suspect window (02:30-02:50) and tag them with suspect-SEC-5187.

build-bot: CI job note: recent commit 9a7f2 changed cosign key path from kms://projects/redwood-prod/.../image-signer to kms://projects/redwood-prod/.../prod-image-signer. Could be dev/test leak.

kyle: OK once export is complete we remove the external principals. After that create new key version and update staging builder to use it. We'll need to coordinate canary to ensure nothing breaks.

auditor-marc: Confirmed export started and a manifest created: gs://redwood-audit-evidence/SEC-5187/manifest.json. Backfill success rate: 78% (some logs lost due to sink downtime).

ops-rita: External members removed at 2026-04-02T02:54Z. I added an IAM note: SEC-5187 temporary containment.

paul: Start rotation now. kyle, can you handle creating new key version and updating key alias?

kyle: Creating new key version v2 now and granting roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to builder-prod only. Command run: 
```
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=prod-image-signer --location=global --keyring=artifacts --project=redwood-prod
```

sec-bot: New key version created v2 at 2026-04-02T03:00:10Z. Old version set to disabled for signing.

paul: Next: rebuild images that had suspect signatures. nana please coordinate rebuild and vuln scan.

ana: Kicking off rebuild pipeline for base-image and 3 dependent images. Builds pushed to staging with new key reference. Will run CVE scan after sign.

build-bot: Rebuilds queued: base-image (job 7721), runtime-layer (7722), tooling-image (7723). Estimated 18m.

auditor-marc: Create an evidence packet including manifest, exported logs, registry snapshot, and a list of impacted digests. I logged ticket SEC-5187 with severity HIGH.

ops-rita: Also adding an alert rule: if any KMS sign occurs from principals outside 'redwood-prod' org, page sec-oncall.

kyle: After rebuilds pass, we'll rotate production consumers to new key and perform limited rollout. No prod deploys until audit signs off.

paul: Owners and ETAs:
- ops-rita: export & IAM removal (done)
- kyle: new key version + RBAC tighten (done)
- nana: rebuilds + vuln scans (ETA 25m)
- auditor-marc: evidence packet + signoff (ETA 35m)

nana: Rebuilds completed, all three images signed with v2 keys at 2026-04-02T03:18Z. CVE scan: 0 high, 2 medium findings (being triaged).

auditor-marc: Evidence packet uploaded: gs://redwood-audit-evidence/SEC-5187/evidence.zip. Note: missing ~22% of KMS access logs; we will include sink health logs and incident timeline.

sec-bot: Post-incident suggestions: add CI preflight that verifies signing principal equals expected builder SA, enforce KMS IAM binding via terraform drift detection, and add manifest signing transparency checks.

paul: Agree. Filing follow-ups: SEC-5187-1 (CI check), SEC-5187-2 (terraform drift rule), SEC-5187-3 (transparency log).

ops-rita: Closing containment ticket. Leaving rotated key in place and monitoring. Will re-open if any anomalies.

ana: Thanks all — will ping when medium CVE triage complete.
